tier1.headline: Your Biometric Data Is Collected
tier1.quote: Biometric information if you choose to provide it, such as fingerprints in Google’s product development studies.

tier1.headline: Your Data Trains Google's AI
tier1.quote: For example, we use publicly available information to help train Google’s AI models and build products and features like Google Translate, Gemini Apps, and Cloud AI capabilities.

tier1.headline: Your Financial Data Is Collected
tier1.quote: Commercial information such as your payment information and a history of purchases you make on Google’s services.

tier1.headline: Your Data Is Collected Without Account
tier1.quote: And you can use many Google services when you’re signed out or without creating an account at all, like searching on Google or watching YouTube videos.

tier2.headline: Your Data Is Shared Broadly
tier2.quote: This Privacy Policy applies to all of the services offered by Google LLC and its affiliates, including YouTube, Android, and services offered on third-party sites, such as advertising services.

tier2.headline: Your Data Is Retained Long-Term
tier2.quote: And some data we retain for longer periods of time when necessary for legitimate business or legal purposes, such as security, fraud and abuse prevention, or financial record-keeping.

tier2.headline: Your Precise Location Is Tracked
tier2.quote: Depending on these settings, this may include precise location data, for example GPS data for Android features like navigation or finding your phone.

tier2.headline: Your Behavior Is Profiled
tier2.quote: We use automated systems that analyze your content to provide you with things like customized search results, personalized ads, or other features tailored to how you use our services.

tier2.headline: Your Data Is Transferred Globally
tier2.quote: We maintain servers around the world and your information may be processed on servers located outside of the country where you live.

tier2.headline: Your Data Shared Without Warrant
tier2.quote: We will share personal information outside of Google if we have a good-faith belief that disclosure of the information is reasonably necessary to: Respond to any applicable law, regulation, legal process, or enforceable governmental request.

tier2.headline: Your Deletion Is Not Immediate
tier2.quote: Because of this, there may be delays between when you delete something and when copies are deleted from our active and backup systems.
